name: Agriculture Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public agriculture data.

entries.title: FAOSTAT
entries.description: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization's global statistical database covering agricultural production, trade, land use, and food security for nearly every country and territory.
entries.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). Bulk downloads available via FAOSTAT's own bulk-download API in addition to the interactive browser. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.

entries.title: USDA ERS Farm Income and Wealth Statistics
entries.description: The Economic Research Service's official U.S. and state-level estimates of farm sector income, assets, debt, and wealth, plus U.S.-level forecasts for the current calendar year.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Economic Research Service (USDA ERS)
entries.attribution: USDA Economic Research Service, Farm Income and Wealth Statistics
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 (the trailing-slash URL redirects to the slashless form). Page shows "Updated: 9/3/2026" and states the three-releases-per-year schedule.
Released three times a year (early February, late August/early September, late November/early December). The schema has no such value, so it is recorded as irregular.
